channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: Mission Creek Park now records the Assessor lots it overlaps.
item.description: Mission Creek Park now records the Assessor lots it overlaps. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 3810006, 8710002.

item.description: Added a photo taken on site on September 28, 2026. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: The summary called the park a waterfront park on Mission Creek's south bank; SF Rec & Park describes Mission Creek Park (North and South), and the record's map shape sits largely on the north/west bank, so the summary now follows Rec & Park's description. The P3 milestone said the extension is west of Fourth Street; Potrero View puts the existing park west of Fourth Street and says P3 extends it toward China Basin Park, so that phrase was removed and the fall-2021 target now cites Potrero View. 'One of the earliest parcels' now cites SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 timeline (first parks opened at Mission Creek P1 and Mission Bay Commons P17 in 2002), which also supports the P1 opening year in the map notes. The July 1, 2023 management change no longer says 'from OCII/the Port' (the Rec & Park page does not say that), and the map notes no longer credit the Rec & Park page with an opening date. The caveat about other OpenStreetMap shapes is marked as unchecked, and the pump-station identification (Assessor blklot 3806006 at 455 Berry St confirmed) is noted as Pier & Point's own. The OCII deck's 'CAC Item 2' label came from a file name and was dropped from the source title, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.
item.description: The summary called the park a waterfront park on Mission Creek's south bank; SF Rec & Park describes Mission Creek Park (North and South), and the record's map shape sits largely on the north/west bank, so the summary now follows Rec & Park's description. The P3 milestone said the extension is west of Fourth Street; Potrero View puts the existing park west of Fourth Street and says P3 extends it toward China Basin Park, so that phrase was removed and the fall-2021 target now cites Potrero View. 'One of the earliest parcels' now cites SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 timeline (first parks opened at Mission Creek P1 and Mission Bay Commons P17 in 2002), which also supports the P1 opening year in the map notes. The July 1, 2023 management change no longer says 'from OCII/the Port' (the Rec & Park page does not say that), and the map notes no longer credit the Rec & Park page with an opening date. The caveat about other OpenStreetMap shapes is marked as unchecked, and the pump-station identification (Assessor blklot 3806006 at 455 Berry St confirmed) is noted as Pier & Point's own. The OCII deck's 'CAC Item 2' label came from a file name and was dropped from the source title, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. Source: SF Rec & Park, Mission Creek Park (North and South) (https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449); Potrero View, 2021-05 (https://www.potreroview.net/mission-creek-park-p3-will-open-this-fall/); SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Workshop 3 presentation, 2025-04-29 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf).

item.title: Complete · Mission Creek Park: Mission Creek Stormwater Park (the P3 extension, 1.2 acres at 1000 Channel St, bounded by China Basin Channel) completed, per a Landscape Performance Series case study -- resolves this project's own prior open question of whether the fall-2021 target opening reported by Potrero View in May 2021 (after a COVID-19 construction pause) actually happened on schedule; it slipped about a year further (Oct 2022)

item.title: Under construction · Mission Creek Park: Construction begins on the Mission Creek Park P3 extension (1.65 acres behind One Mission Bay, extending the park to align with China Basin Park), following a mid-2019 permit; substantially complete was originally targeted for end of 2020 (~2019)
